## Activity

River Outreach recorded 63 captures during June 2025. This figure represents the activity recorded for the site and month covered by this report. The activity measure is presented together with image quality and grading results to provide a concise operational summary. No additional activity measure is included in the available results.

## Image quality

Of the 63 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.3. These results are reported separately from the grading outcome so that the number of captures requiring consideration for image quality is clear. The image-quality figures apply to the June 2025 activity at River Outreach.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results. The median lag was 1. The referable result count and median lag are reported as the available grading measures for the period. Taken together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide the operational summary for River Outreach in June 2025.
